findings.title: ITC beginning-of-construction cliff unverifiable — ~30% of project economics at stake
findings.text: Under OBBBA (July 2025) and IRS Notice 2025-42, solar >1.5 MW must document physical-work BOC by Jul 4, 2026 (no 5% safe harbor) or be placed in service by Dec 31, 2027, else ITC/PTC = $0. The dossier has no COD, no BOC evidence, and no tax-credit assumption, so the largest go/no-go financial variable is undocumented. Storage ITC under Section 48E survives regardless.

findings.title: Interconnection position unknown in NV Energy BAA cluster process
findings.text: No queue position, cluster phase, POI, or network-upgrade cost estimate exists. The project sits in NV Energy BAA (NEVP OASIS) under FERC Order 2023 cluster rules where site control gates entry. Base rates: ~20% of queued projects reach COD, IR-to-COD ~5 yrs, network-upgrade cost shock drives ~30% post-screen attrition. Any POI relying on planned transmission (e.g., Greenlink West 525 kV, energizing 2027) carries multi-year delay distribution.

findings.title: Desert tortoise protocol surveys and MSHCP coverage undocumented
findings.text: Clark County is Mojave desert tortoise (federally threatened) habitat. On non-federal land the Clark County MSHCP Section 10 permit applies (~$550/ac, ~$0.6M on 1,080 ac) and 100%-coverage protocol surveys gate layout freeze; the survey window is Sep-Oct and missing it costs +6 months. Any BLM nexus triggers ESA Section 7 plus elevated DOI review under EO 14315 / SO 3438 (confirmed live on BLM.gov). No biological survey, take coverage, or fee line item appears in the dossier.

findings.title: Land status and zoning jurisdiction unknown — BLM vs private vs Boulder City ER
findings.text: The 1,080-ac parcel's land status is undocumented. BLM surface or gen-tie crossing means 2024 Western Solar Plan conformance + FLPMA ROW + NEPA (Townsite Solar 2 precedent ~2-3 yrs, under IBLA appeal) plus elevated DOI review. Boulder City means the receptive Energy Resource zoning path (BCMC Title 11; 17,107 ac ER-zoned; city solar-lease program confirmed live). Unincorporated Clark County means a county SUP path. Timelines and denial risk differ materially; none can be confirmed.
